rounds.prompt: How many 8 oz (240 ml) cups of coffee can you brew from one arabica coffee tree's yearly harvest?
rounds.source: Starbucks Coffee Blog, 'Roast Story': each coffee tree produces the equivalent of about a pound of roasted beans per year · Specialty Coffee Association Golden Cup standard: 55 g of coffee per liter of water, about 12 to 14.5 g for an 8 oz (240 ml) cup
rounds.qualifier: Using 0.5 oz (14 g) of ground coffee per cup.

rounds.prompt: Roger Federer played tour-level singles from 1998 to 2021. How many different opponents did he face?
rounds.source: Ultimate Tennis Statistics, Federer rivalries table: 350 distinct tour-level opponents

rounds.prompt: A PGA Tour pro tees off on the Moon. How far does a normal drive fly?
rounds.source: Trackman PGA Tour driver averages (171 mph, 10.4°) · NASA lunar gravity 1.62 m/s²
rounds.qualifier: The ball leaves the club at 171 mph (275 km/h), 10.4 degrees up.
